The company name error ("ApexCorp" instead of "OmniCorp") is also concerning but appears to be a typo in the overview section only.

The overall effect is that the model output presents a more positive picture than warranted, particularly regarding the security incidents, which are significant negative findings that should be prominently highlighted.
